privacyBody: Simcoe County Turkish Association processes personal information only for membership, event registration, communication and community services.
Collected information may include name, email, phone, membership plan, event participation details and messages shared voluntarily.
Data is stored securely in Firebase and selected service providers. Role-based access and security rules are used to prevent unauthorized access.
You may contact us to request correction or deletion of your personal information.
termsBody: By using this website, you agree to follow the Simcoe County Turkish Association platform rules.
Content shared in the member portal must be respectful, accurate and supportive of community safety.
The association reserves the right to remove inappropriate content and limit account access when necessary.
Events, memberships and announcements may be updated by the association board.

about.title: A strong Turkish community in Simcoe
about.intro: Simcoe County Turkish Association is an independent community organization working to preserve cultural heritage, support newcomers and build lasting solidarity among members.
about.mission: To bring the Turkish community in Simcoe together through culture, education, support and volunteerism.
about.vision: To be a strong community where newcomers settle with confidence, families find support and our culture is passed across generations.
about.history: Started in 2018 by volunteer families, STA has grown into a Simcoe County community network with events, guidance programs and membership services.
